stage_B.validation_note: Validation has repeated subject occurrences across folds; report counts and unique IDs, not an OOF cohort.
stage_B.test_note: 871 unique test subjects per seed; repeated seeds are same subjects; diagnostic post-hoc analysis, not conditional mutual information.

interpretation: 选择D：原生图推理效应极弱，校准及邻居对照未共同建立可靠条件增量；实验8小幅改善更接近训练期辅助正则化迹象，但本轮没有直接证明联合优化的唯一因果机制。
next_direction: 在独立预注册、无RFE跨折泄漏并含站点外验证的协议中，先检验一个固定影像关系基准上的表型邻居疾病增量；在确认非冗余信息之前暂停为当前年龄/性别关系继续增加对齐或Gate复杂度。

report_review.site_note: Descriptive pooled held-out subjects within each site and seed; no independent-cohort or significance claim.
report_review.empty_convolution_statistics_note: n=0 means not comparable after pooled node/order changes; numerical zero placeholders must not be interpreted as zero effect.
report_review.wall_time_note: Runtime begins at audit.started_epoch; excludes code writing and later report-only review and repeated terminal verification.
